source: Cambodian MAFF/agricultural extension PowerPoint-derived presentation titled "ដំណាំឪឡឹក" (Watermelon), 42 slides; no presenter, publisher, or date named on the slides reviewed. This presentation exists as two near-identical PDF copies in the source set (one with a green-themed slide design, one plain black-on-white reformat of the same 42 slides) - treat as one source, not two corroborating sources.
text:
Several commercial seed companies and their recommended watermelon varieties are named: the Chea Tai seed group offers the "Summer" variety; the Takii Seed group offers the "New Dragon" variety; and the Known You Seed group also offers a "New Dragon" variety.

When choosing which variety/seed lot to plant, farmers should consider: the production date (day, month, year) the seed was produced; the germination percentage of the seed lot; and the shelf life (viable storage lifespan) of the seed.
